info.title: MoneySuite FinOps API – Global Collections and AI-Powered Bill Payments
info.description: Automate and save cash and time with MoneySuite’s unified API platform for collections, banking, and payments — including billing, embedded payments, bank accounts, subscriptions, and credit control, globally.

tags.name: 1. Automated (AR) Collections API
tags.description: A automated collections suite of comprising of all billing, mutli-rail embedded payments, credit control, reconciliation and bookkeeping.

tags.name: 2. Subscriptions and Recurring (AR) Payments API
tags.description: Subscription API for plan creation, customer subscriptions, and related features, combined with payment mandate management for cards and Direct Debit, enabling variable recurring collections.

tags.name: 3. AI-Powered Bill Payments (AP) API
tags.description: An AI-powered bill payments API for scanning, categorising and paying bills end to end.

tags.name: 4. International Accounts & Payments (AP) API
tags.description: International collections and payments with international collection accounts, foreign exchange, beneficiary management, and global payments.

tags.name: 5. Payment Onboarding API
tags.description: Onboarding and setup for all payment types, including bank payments, cards, pull payments (Direct Debit and SEPA), as well as international accounts and payments.
